latest.title: Muito Além do Código: O Papel da AWS na Formação de um Cientista de Dados
latest.description:
A Amazon Web Services (AWS)
 vem transformando a formação de cientistas de dados ao unir teoria, prática e infraestrutura em escala global. Mais do que aprender programação, estudantes passam a desenvolver visão estratégica, análise de dados e soluções reais utilizadas pelo mercado. Em um cenário movido por inteligência artificial e cloud computing, dominar AWS tornou-se essencial para profissionais que desejam crescer na área de dados.

latest.title: The Pre-Check Architecture: When NOT to Call Your LLM
latest.description: A mental model for production agentic systems: the single biggest cost lever is calling the LLM less often, not making each call cheaper. The Decision Gate Spectrum reframes how architects think about agent computation.

latest.title: Containment Architecture for Autonomous AI Agents
latest.description: A four-layer containment model that prevents autonomous AI agents from executing harmful actions, shifting the safety conversation from what goes into the model to what comes out of it.

latest.title: Multi-Agent Coordination Without a Central Orchestrator
latest.description: The supervisor agent pattern is the first thing every team reaches for and the first thing that breaks. Decentralized coordination through intent broadcasting scales linearly, fails gracefully, and costs less per decision.

latest.title: Fine-tune Small Language Models for Production-Grade Tool Calling with GRPO using Hugging Face TRL on Amazon SageMaker AI
latest.description: Fine-tune Qwen3 (1.7B & 4B) with GRPO and verifiable rewards on SageMaker AI to build production-grade tool-calling agents. Using automated reward functions instead of labeled data, RL-tuned sub-4B models hit 0.96 exact match and 0.95 schema accuracy on financial APIs, outperforming GPT-OSS-120B and matching models 10–70× their size. Prototype with LLMs, deploy fine-tuned SLMs for enterprise-scale agentic workflows at a fraction of the latency and cost.

latest.title: From Chaos to Spec: Stop Improvising and Start Engineering
latest.description: Discover how to replace unpredictable "vibe coding" with Spec Driven Development using Kiro, an AI orchestrator that utilizes steering files and sub-agents to build production-ready systems. This approach transforms engineering workflows by turning structured specifications into executable artifacts for faster, more consistent results.

latest.title: UPDATE (May 8, 2026): The Deal Landed
latest.description: In the early morning hours yesterday EU negotiators reached a provisional agreement on the AI Omnibus. The high-risk AI deadline moves from August 2, 2026 to December 2, 2027 for standalone systems (credit scoring, fraud detection, biometrics, employment decisions). AI embedded in regulated products gets until August 2, 2028.

trending.description: ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is an AI-powered claim verification platform built on AWS that verifies scientific claims against 1.2M+ peer-reviewed papers across 8 domains — and automatically fetches and permanently stores new papers from arXiv, PubMed, etc. when gaps are found, making the knowledge base self-growing with every query. From typed claims to YouTube videos and uploaded documents, ASET delivers evidence-backed trust scores in under 10 seconds.
